recentItems.title: WABC Channel 7 Eyewitness News This Morning (Full), 2/22/2025 (Last Show from 7 Lincoln Square)
recentItems.description:
JOIN BROADCAST PLAZA TODAY, DISCORD'S MEDIA DISCUSSION COMMUNITY — http://bit.ly/S31MA

Complete 9am hour of the morning newscast from the ABC-owned station in New York City. Recorded on Saturday, February 22, 2025.

This is the last newscast from the station's old facility located at 7 Lincoln Square, which the station had called home since 1979. That evening, they would relocate to a brand new facility, 7 Hudson Square, leaving behind the Upper West Side for Lower Manhattan. Disney is consolidating all of their New York offices from several buildings to this new structure.

A new set would accompany the move, but the graphics (group package designed by Vivid Zero), music ("Eyewitness News" from Gari Music) and voiceover (Charlie Van Dyke) all stayed the same, as expected. The set you see here came into use in 2012 and was a streetside studio, with the space previously being used by a location of the Disney Store.

Anchored by Pedro Rivera and Michelle Charlesworth with weather from meteorologist Dani Beckstrom, and Anthony Johnson with sports. Includes reports from Marcus Solis, Morgan Norwood (ABC News), Nina Pineda, Johny Fernandez (ABC News), and Kemberly Richardson. Lee Goldberg and Sade Baderinwa also came in towards the end to help close down the studio.

Commercials and promos have been retained.

Open and close from the 10pm newscast on the ABC affiliate in Madison, Wisconsin. The station is owned by Allen Media Group. Recorded on Sunday, September 15, 2024.

This was recorded when WKOW still had separate weekend newscasts. A couple of months later, Allen made changes at all of their Wisconsin stations that led to WKOW becoming a hub for the rest of the state, while sacrificing jobs at other stations. WKOW's midday and weekend newscasts are now simulcast statewide under the "Wisconsin News Now" name.

The station uses the former Quincy Media group graphics package, "In-Sink" from Warner Chappell Production Music, and Josh Goodman voiceover.

Grace Houdek anchors with weather from meteorologist Alexis Clemons (now at WVIT).

recentItems.title: KIMT News 3 at 10:00 Open, 2/3/2025 (New Voiceover)
recentItems.description:
JOIN BROADCAST PLAZA TODAY, DISCORD'S MEDIA DISCUSSION COMMUNITY — http://bit.ly/S31MA

Open from the 10pm newscast on the CBS affiliate in Mason City, Iowa-Albert Lea-Austin-Rochester, Minnesota. The station is owned by Allen Media Group. Recorded on Monday, February 3, 2025.

Just one week after KIMT switched to a new hub model where KWWL is doing a lot of the legwork now, and also after adopting their presentation elements, KIMT also changed their voiceover to match KWWL as well, with Josh Goodman now being the new station voice for KIMT. 

I'm guessing this was to bring them more in line with KWWL, though Steve Davis works for SpotVoice, who does not enforce market exclusivity on their talent. Davis was also voicing the weekend news opens for KTTC/KEYC, so perhaps they were also uncomfortable having their announcer also heard on a competitor.

The newly minted Quincy graphics package and 360 music package are of course unchanged. Though some of the on-set graphics have now been changed to match the new graphics.

Kamie Roeseler anchors with weather from chief meteorologist Aaron White.

recentItems.title: KTAL NBC 6 News at 6:00 Open, 12/31/2024 (Short-Lived Open)
recentItems.description:
JOIN BROADCAST PLAZA TODAY, DISCORD'S MEDIA DISCUSSION COMMUNITY — http://bit.ly/S31MA

Open from the 6pm newscast on the Nexstar-owned NBC affiliate in the Shreveport, Louisiana - Texarkana, Texas market. Recorded on Tuesday, December 31, 2024.

This open style was used for approximately two newscasts: 5pm and 6pm that night, before the NBC-01 graphics package and "Inergy" music theme was restored at 10pm.

Nexstar and NBC were in affiliation renewal discussions that apparently went down to the wire, and were close enough to the point some stations, like KTAL, began to pull NBC references in the event the plug was indeed pulled. As it turned out, the two sides ultimately would come to an agreement on a renewal, which was announced on January 8, 2025, several days after the previous agreement expired. It appeared to be done prematurely on the part of KTAL, which might have been why the NBC branding was restored hours later.

It is unknown where the graphics came from, whether they were done in-house or bought online. The music is the production track "News Today" from Production Music Online. The open doesn't have a voiceover but the "Forecast First" bump did and that's Charlie Van Dyke.

Anchored by Alexandra Meachum with weather from meteorologist Josh Marcisz.
